text: The company was founded by my grandfather in 1974.
Most files are removed at the first pass.
He was tasked with the pricing brief in 2021.
The third project was turned around by his team.
In 2021 I was tasked with writing the pricing process down.
Three projects are run at the same time, and each one is managed by a site engineer.
The turnaround was attributed to the site team, and it should have been.
Most of what I do now was not in the job I was trained for.

A file gets about eleven minutes from me on the first pass, and I want to be honest about what I am doing in those eleven minutes. I am not looking for the best written pages. I am looking for claims I can check. A resume that is all adjectives is boilerplate, and boilerplate does not get rejected, which is the part candidates never believe. It gets overlooked. Nobody in this office decides against it. It simply does not survive the screening, and no one ever writes down why. The sentences that make me stop have a number in them, or a date, or a name. Twenty-five employees. Three sites. In 2021 he was tasked with something specific, and here is what came out of it. A claim that can be verified is worth more to me than a claim that is beautifully phrased, and I would say that is the single thing I would tell every applicant if I were allowed to tell them one thing.

I have written maybe forty of these letters and I got the first ten of them wrong. I praised everything. I thought that was the job. Those letters are read as boilerplate and they are worth nothing, and the reason is simple once somebody explains it to you: a letter with no limit in it has nobody's judgement in it. If I say a person is outstanding in every direction, I have told you about my enthusiasm and not about him. The paragraph that gets believed is the one that names a real shortcoming and then says what he did about it. That paragraph is the reason the rest of the letter is believed at all, and I have watched it work. One more thing, on who to ask. People chase the most senior name they can reach. Do not. Ask somebody who can vouch for a specific result with figures in front of them. Seniority with no detail reads as a favour, and everybody on the other side of the desk knows it.

Most files are removed at the first pass.
In 2021 I was tasked with writing the pricing process down.
The letter was written by a client.
